name: Kuraku Nattara Kyoushitsu de
source:
Two beautiful girl sneak into school building at night as a part of courage test. But they get into a trap and face severe punishment.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
作为勇气测试的一部分，两个美丽的女孩在晚上潜入学校大楼。但他们却陷入了陷阱并面临严厉的惩罚。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
